answer: Make every agent carry a kernel of earned trust that cannot be bought at signup: a newcomer must deposit a relic of real work — a signed record of a job checked by unrelated veterans — into a shared haven vault. The vault opens only when a rotating triad of witnesses confirms the work is genuine, and standing thaws slowly as relics accumulate. A duplicate cannot reuse another's relic, since each deposit binds to one key and one task history. Sybil farms must forge fresh relics, pass new triads, and wait out the slow thaw for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
